parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Space: a setback and new builders

  • PSLV-C62 carrying EOS-01 (earth observation) and 15 other satellites failed from Sriharikota due to a fault in the PS3 (third) stage – the PSLV's second failure in a row.
  • Godrej Aerospace delivered the human-rated Vikas engine for the L-110 stage of LVM3, the Gaganyaan launcher.
  • Foundation laid for India's first integrated private satellite factory by Ajista Space at Khoraj, Sanand (Gujarat).
  • Pixxel signed an MoU with IN-SPACe for India's first private earth-observation constellation, 'Firefly'.
  • NASA did its first medical evacuation from space, bringing Crew-11 back early from the ISS.
  • Russia placed 52 satellites in orbit from Vostochny on a Soyuz-2.1b.

Missiles, rockets and defence tech

  • DRDO fired two Pralay missiles in quick succession from Chandipur: surface-to-surface, quasi-ballistic, solid fuel, 150–500 km; made by Research Centre Imarat, Hyderabad.
  • First flight test of the Pinaka extended-range guided rocket; the first Pinaka export lot left Nagpur for Armenia. The launcher fires 12 rockets in 44 seconds.
  • Third-generation MP-ATGM ('fire and forget', imaging infrared seeker) tested at KK Range, Ahilyanagar (Maharashtra).
  • Suryastra universal rocket launcher (150–300 km) to be made by Pune's NIBE Ltd with Israel's Elbit Systems, based on its PULS system.
  • DRDL Hyderabad ground-tested a full-scale, actively cooled scramjet engine for hypersonic missiles.
  • DRDO marked its 68th Foundation Day on 1 January; Chairman Samir V. Kamat. It handed seven TDF-scheme technologies to the forces.
  • Pravaig Veer (Bengaluru) is India's first all-electric military vehicle.
  • HAL is setting up a helicopter MRO hub at Missamari, Assam.
Foreign weapons in news: Russia's Oreshnik – hypersonic intermediate-range ballistic missile, about Mach 10, up to 5,000 km, MIRV. China's YJ-20 – hypersonic anti-ship missile fired from a Type-055 destroyer. Taiwan's Narwhal (Hai Kun) – first home-built submarine, sea trials begun.

AI, robots and computing

  • India's first Sovereign AI Park will come up in Chennai – Tamil Nadu signed an MoU with Sarvam AI (Rs 10,000 crore).
  • Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut becomes India's first AI-enabled state university (with MSDE and Google Cloud).
  • India's first AI clinic in a government hospital opened at GIMS, Greater Noida.
  • OncoMark: AI tool reading cancer 'hallmarks', built by the S.N. Bose National Centre and Ashoka University; trained on 3.1 million cells of 14 cancers.
  • DRISHTI: Indian Railways' AI system that detects tampering of door locks on moving freight trains.
  • Param Shakti supercomputer (3.1 petaflops) opened at IIT Madras.
  • Humanoid robot 'ASC Arjun' deployed at Visakhapatnam station to help the RPF – a first for Indian Railways.
  • SCOPR: India's first legged mobile manipulator robot, by xTerra Robotics with IIT Kanpur.
  • Google released TranslateGemma (open translation models, 55 languages); Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome to predict effects of DNA mutations.

Life sciences and labs

  • Kerala declared Bacillus subtilis its state microorganism – the first state to do so.
  • Gegenophis valmikii, a new blind caecilian (limbless burrowing amphibian), was found in the northern Western Ghats of Maharashtra.
  • Foundation stone laid for a BSL-4 bio-containment lab at Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre, Gandhinagar.
  • A DST-funded NIDHI Centre of Excellence (Rs 40 crore) set up at IIM Ahmedabad.
